notes.title: The demo version has been revamped!
notes.notes:
-The demo version now  includes the entire tutorial.
-Arcade mode "Mission Awaken : Very Hard” can now be played in its entirety.
　*There is no difficulty or mission selection, and only the Lanmo Tribe ships can be used.
-Chronicle mission can be played up to 8 stages.
-Supported languages have been expanded to include Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

This updated demo version features a sufficient amount of content to enjoy the full scope of what the game has to offer.
[b]Please recommend this game to your friends and family! [/b]

notes.title: [Patch note: Build0320] Fixed issues with online leaderboard.
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where Online Leaderboard was not working.
(In case your PC performance is too low, scores may not be reflected online)

notes.title: [Patch note: Build0319] Chinese translation fixes
notes.notes: - Fixed garbled characters and translation omissions in Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

notes.title: [Patch Note: Build0309] Implementation of new language and new features
notes.notes:
-Added the Traditional Chinese option in the language menu.
-Added Illustration Gallery.
-Added Rumble Feature for controller setting.
-Added option to turn off Very Hard tutorial overlay.
-Fixed bug relating to acquisition of story mode fragments.
-Adjusted the strength of some weapons and ship bodies.
-Fixed a bug causing abnormal display of options in the option menu. (Name registration, Crosshair, ship shadow etc.)
-Fixed other various bugs, and made other minor balance adjustments.

notes.title: [Patch note: Build0125] Implementation of Simplified Chinese, etc.
notes.notes:
- The game is now officially supports simplified Chinese.
- Added the following startup options to setting.txt (normally you do not need to change them)

WINDOW =0
0 to select at startup, 1 to start in windowed mode, 2 to start in full screen.

GRAPHIC_BOARD =0
0 to use the best performing graphics board, 1 to use the second best performing graphics board.
Disabled if there is no output destination ( Output Device ).

VSYNC =0
0 to VSync on, 1 to VSync off.
If the game operation becomes slow, setting to 1 may improve the operation.

- Other minor fixes.
